summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 4.II/813)

data.turoyo: Mawxa ste ənnu kowe ʕasquṯo, ənnu ḥa d mšaḥləf u mede d ḥzele kule, d xləqle b meḥe, d qodər han naqqa d moyəd zabno karyo d mḥaləq u meḥo ʕatiqo w d maḥət u meḥo ḥaṯo b qarʕe.
data.translation: So there is difficulty for a person to change everything he has seen, which he has created in his mind, to be able now to take a short time to throw away the old mind and put the new mind in his head.

rationale: First active Infectum/1 box: a person changes learned mental contents, with overt object; participant extension of inherited change.
